selection.objective: Expected value of the next marginal information/development dollar, with remaining clinical risk, cost, time and capturable value
selection.selected_uncertainty: Whether the exact NDC9009 topical article can support a useful claim at tolerable epidermal exposure with an incremental product contribution and plausible retained value
selection.basis: Next eligible bounded source sprint after APR, RM and BLU closure; prior independent conditional order challenged with exact article, comparator and patent/program evidence

qualification.original_scope: Topical exposure and established-barrier question; not a clinical program.
qualification.current_interpretation: Retain the original topical-exposure and established-barrier/useful-function decision as the rank4 assumption. A preliminary qualification-only deliverable is a separately re-compared tranche and does not inherit that rank or EV rationale.

routes.route: Incumbent-linked or separately differentiated development contribution

branches.condition: Authenticated article, interpretable exposure/function route and plausible contribution fit the bounded scope
branches.decision: Consider only the qualified next tranche

branches.condition: Useful reproducible function, tolerated local exposure and meaningful comparator advantage
branches.decision: Consider confirmation and next product question; no automatic human efficacy or financial value

branches.condition: A properly qualified negative rejects established-deficit repair but credible evidence supports a different useful claim
branches.decision: Stop repair claim; separately assess and price prevention/control; preserve the negative

branches.condition: Only markers/assembly improve, or exposure/model/tolerance is unqualified
branches.decision: Do not advance unsupported claim; distinguish inconclusive qualification from biological failure

branches.condition: No useful advantage over simpler care or no obtainable contribution retaining sufficient value
branches.decision: Stop financial route or reassess a genuinely different contribution

branches.condition: Chemistry/model/rights/comparator requirements expand cost/time, or the deliverable answers less than the original useful-function question
branches.decision: Re-rank actual revised commitment and information yield against alternatives and waiting, even if the price is unchanged

decision: Retain conditional NDC qualification option; sharpen incremental product/capture and claim-specific gates; close selected public-source pass without promotion or automatic spending

clinical_context_sources.scope: Original consensus document read for chronic symptomatic-care/claim context, not NDC efficacy

reopen_for: Exact-NDC delayed or clinically useful preventive/control function
Measured dissolved or viable-epidermis exposure and local tolerance
Relevant controlled comparator outcome with usable denominators

Exact rights/supply/access/cost fact changing an executable contribution
